grammar.title: In a row with 连续
grammar.pattern: 连续 + 数量 + 量词 + 名词
grammar.explanation: 连续 (liánxù) means "continuous, in a row" — placed before a number and measure word, it shows something repeats without a break. It's common for describing streaks, like consecutive days or wins.

grammar.title: In person with 亲自
grammar.explanation: 亲自 (qīnzì) means "personally, in person" — it emphasizes that someone did something themselves, rather than through someone else. It goes right before the verb.

sentences.pinyin: Tā qīnzì zuò le zhè dào cài.

sentences.zh: 老师亲自回答了我的问题。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī qīnzì huídá le wǒ de wèntí.
sentences.en: The teacher personally answered my question.

sentences.zh: 她说话的时候显得有点儿紧张。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shuōhuà de shíhou xiǎnde yǒudiǎnr jǐnzhāng.
sentences.en: She seemed a bit nervous while speaking.
